<set-variable name="aforo-customer-source" value="@{
        var existing = context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-customer-id")
            ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-customer-id"]) : "";
        if (existing != null && existing.Trim().Length > 0) { return "preset"; }
        var payload = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-jwt-payload", null) as JObject;
        if (payload != null) {
            var fromJwt = Convert.ToString(payload["customer_id"]);
            if (fromJwt != null && fromJwt.Trim().Length > 0) { return "jwt"; }
        }
        if (context.Subscription == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Subscription.Id)) { return "none"; }
        return "map";
    }" />
    
    
        
            
        
    
    <set-variable name="aforo-customer-id" value="@{
        var existing = context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-customer-id")
            ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-customer-id"]) : "";
        if (existing != null && existing.Trim().Length > 0) { return existing.Trim(); }
        var payload = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-jwt-payload", null) as JObject;
        if (payload != null) {
            var fromJwt = Convert.ToString(payload["customer_id"]);
            if (fromJwt != null && fromJwt.Trim().Length > 0) { return fromJwt.Trim(); }
        }
        if (context.Subscription == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Subscription.Id)) { return ""; }
        if (context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-customer-map-cached")) {
            var hit = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-customer-map-cached"]);
            return hit == null || hit == "~" ? "" : hit;
        }
        var subId = context.Subscription.Id;
        var map = context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-subscription-customer-map")
            ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-subscription-customer-map"]) : "";
        if (map == null || map.Trim().Length == 0) { map = "{{aforo-subscription-customer-map}}"; }
        foreach (var entry in map.Split(';', '\n')) {
            var idx = entry.IndexOf("=");
            if (idx <= 0) { continue; }
            if (entry.Substring(0, idx).Trim() == subId) { return entry.Substring(idx + 1).Trim(); }
        }
        return "";
    }" />
